def profile_jets(raw,points):
    from bhsm.interface.muon_holomorphic_normal_geometry import _geometry_variables,_fields,_sqrt,_response,anchored_holomorphic_chart,_compose,_sin
    q,v,m,delta,wd,wall,_=_geometry_variables(raw);chart=anchored_holomorphic_chart(delta.value)
    posrate=np.zeros(100,complex);posrate[:37]=raw[37:74];posrate[98]=raw[99]
    vals=[];grads=[]
    names=('N','R','C','beta','beta_r','n_r','h0','h4','logw_t','logw_r',
        'f','f_t','f_r','sigma_t','sigma_r','sigma','lambda')
    for rho in points:
        chi=float(rho)*wall/(np.pi/2);a=_fields(12,q,v,m,chi);f=_response(chi,delta,wd,chart)
        R=a['A']*a['B']/_sqrt(a['A']**2+a['B']**2);C=a['C']*wall/(np.pi/2);N=a['N']
        beta=(a['beta']+float(rho)*wd/(np.pi/2))/(wall/(np.pi/2))
        lr=a['ap']+a['bp']-(a['A']**2*a['ap']+a['B']**2*a['bp'])/(a['A']**2+a['B']**2)
        lt=a['la']+a['lb']-(a['A']**2*a['la']+a['B']**2*a['lb'])/(a['A']**2+a['B']**2)
        lw_r=(a['cp']+3*lr)*wall/(np.pi/2)
        lw_t=a['lc']+3*lt+(a['cp']+3*lr)*float(rho)*wd/(np.pi/2)+wd/wall
        h0=(a['lc']+3*lt-a['beta']*(a['cp']+3*lr)-a['betap'])/(2*N)
        h4=(a['np']+3*lr)/(2*a['C'])
        beta_r=a['betap']+wd/wall;n_r=(N/C)*(a['np']-a['cp'])*wall/(np.pi/2)
        ft=f['fdot']+f['fprime']*float(rho)*wd/(np.pi/2);fr=f['fprime']*wall/(np.pi/2)
        sig=f['sigma'];extra=np.r_[np.zeros(37),sig.gradient[:37],np.zeros(25),sig.gradient[98]]
        st=type(sig)(sig.gradient@posrate,sig.hessian@posrate+extra,np.zeros((100,100),complex))
        Z=_compose(delta,chart['normalization'],*chart['normalization_derivatives'][:2])
        sr=.25*_sin(2*f['f'])**2/Z*wall/(np.pi/2)
        lam=a['A']**2/(a['A']**2+a['B']**2)
        row=(N,R,C,beta,beta_r,n_r,h0,h4,lw_t,lw_r,f['f'],ft,fr,st,sr,sig,lam)
        vals.append([x.value for x in row]);grads.append([x.gradient for x in row])
    values=np.array(vals);gradient=np.array(grads)
    assert np.max(abs(values.imag))<2e-12 and np.max(abs(gradient.imag))<2e-12
    return values.real,gradient.real,names,dict(delta=float(delta.value.real),coefficients=chart['coefficients'].real.tolist(),
        normalization=float(chart['normalization'].real),implicit_residual=float(np.max(abs(chart['implicit_residual']))),
        local_material_branch_only=True)
